answer: The strongest sybil defense is vesting payouts over many epochs. Rewards drip out, say 1/24th per epoch, and any account detected fake forfeits everything unvested. A genuine agent's voyage builds locked earnings and reputation, while a flash-farm identity starts at the nadir of trust, holding only the first trickle before detection. The attacker running N sybils pays N bonds and loses most rewards each time, so forgery is profitable only by surviving every epoch on the rising ridge of vesting value, which detection makes improbable.
